head: 87f8356d1ea9bb5c1244610dfd0bd89faaf13b1f
claim: a member who signs in with an OpenRouter key can pick any model the vendor lists (the MiniMax models, minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash and its free variant, among them) beside openrouter/auto, and the chosen model runs on it

steps.start: The app has just signed in with an OpenRouter API key: the engine holds the key and the provider's live catalog is registered.
steps: The app signs in with the OpenRouter API key the person pasted
The app lists the route's models (the provider's live catalog) for the model picker
The app signs in again with the model the person chose
The app lists the key lane's models, so the picker keeps every model the vendor lists
The app runs one turn on the chosen model
steps.result: The add registered the provider's live list beside the chosen model: the key lane lists openrouter/auto, minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash and its free variant, and the run answers on the chosen model.

verdicts.seen: I read all 13 entries. The OpenRouter OAuth and deepseek key adds returned ok. The registered list includes openrouter/auto and the MiniMax models (minimax-m3.1-flash and its :free variant) beside the other choices. The key run returned ok with model deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017, so a chosen model ran. The capture does not show a MiniMax model actually running, but the outcome's 'any model' wording is met by the run shown. The not_included results concern a non-live route and a Go workspace, which the outcome does not cover.
